name: Should I replace my polybutylene pipes even if they haven't leaked yet?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace my polybutylene pipes even if they haven't leaked yet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, proactive replacement of polybutylene pipes is highly recommended, even if you haven't experienced any leaks. The degradation process happens internally, and failures can occur suddenly and catastrophically, leading to extensive water damage, mold growth, and costly repairs. Many homeowners insurance policies also have limitations or exclusions for homes with polybutylene. Replacing them before a failure occurs is a preventative measure that protects your property and provides long-term peace of mind.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, proactive replacement is highly recommended. Internal degradation means sudden, catastrophic leaks can occur without warning, leading to costly damage.
